rules: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Headings (Size > 32px) MUST use tracking-tight.
Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny (text-xs) + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric data, tables, and metric summaries to enforce precision.
H1 ceiling is text-6xl. Do not exceed.
Use Outfit for a tech-startup feel, and IBM Plex Sans for body.
Use 'Swiss & High-Contrast' Light Theme logic.
Deep Navy (#0F2C4C) is the primary structural color, replacing black for high-contrast headers, primary text, and borders.
Teal Accent (#0EA5A0) is ONLY for primary call-to-actions, buttons, and key interactive links. DO NOT use Teal for large background areas or dashboard panels.
Light Teal Tint (#E6F7F5) is strictly used as a soft background for elevated data cards or active states in sidebars.
No generic full-screen gradients. Focus on crisp solid colors with 1px borders.

grids.marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12, wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12), highly asymmetrical spans.
grids.dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6), dense data blocks.

rules: Avoid standard Bootstrap columns. Use overlapping elements.
Hero Image Overlay: bg-white/60 or gradient overlay over skyscrapers for a light, high-end corporate feel. Do not black out the image.
Generous spacing: p-12, p-16, p-24.
Use Glassmorphism (Crystal variant) for sticky headers: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with a 1px border-white/40.
Use tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
Every pixel must be utilized (h-full on children).
Card Style: Flat background (#FFFFFF), 1px subtle border (#E5E7EB), no shadow by default. Hover adds shadow-sm and slightly darkens border.
Grid Borders (The Technical Look): Use border-collapse style layouts for dense data tables.
No Glassmorphism in health/finance apps like this one, except top nav.

surfaces: Use Flat Solid surfaces for Data Dashboards to prevent visual refraction of data.
Use Glassmorphism strictly for the marketing page sticky header.
micro_interactions: All interactive elements MUST have explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-[#0F2C4C]).
Buttons: slight lift (-translate-y-px) and shadow increase on hover.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
For Marketing: Use pure HTML + Tailwind CSS for structure to achieve asymmetry, but Shadcn for interactive logic (Forms).
For Dashboard: Heavily rely on customized Shadcn components (Tables, Dropdowns, Tabs).
Do NOT use Shadcn Card for marketing layouts, use raw divs.
LOGO CREATION: Manually create an SVG for the Veridian logo: a shield built from an interconnected node/circuit pattern forming a 'V' in negative space.

rules: Marketing: Smooth scrolling (lenis), staggered entrances for grids.
Dashboard: Minimalist motion. Focus on micro-interactions for feedback.
NEVER apply universal transitions (transition: all). Use specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform).
Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based (e.g., data-testid='submit-portfolio-button').
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

icons.rules: Use Lucide React for consistent, clean tech icons. Stroke width 1.5 for elegance.

images.description: Foggy modern skyscrapers to establish corporate reinsurance trust and scale on the marketing page.
Abstract data network for the 'Live SSE Processing' view or AI Insight Panel.
Professional businessman portrait for the dashboard user profile or a marketing page trust badge.

rules: Use Recharts for standard data visualization (Exposure charts, CAT Loss Model output).
Use react-globe.gl if building an immersive geographical risk map for the Portfolio-Wide view.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use deep Navy (#0F2C4C) and crisp White (#FFFFFF) to create sharp contrast.
Layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
